SELECT * FROM SYN.STG_CRM_CIFMERGE

SELECT CIFMERGEID, BANK_ID, COUNT(1) CNT FROM SYN.STG_CRM_CIFMERGE
GROUP BY CIFMERGEID, BANK_ID
HAVING COUNT(1) > 1

SELECT * FROM SYN.STG_ATM_CLIENTCARDMAPPING

SELECT CCM_ID, CCM_INS_ID, COUNT(1) CNT FROM SYN.STG_ATM_CLIENTCARDMAPPING
GROUP BY CCM_ID, CCM_INS_ID
HAVING COUNT(1) > 1
